scope: Generated VIEW table-record reference-identity transport for admitted reference fields.

source.title: Autodesk VIEW (DXF)
source.supports: The documented Background, VisualStyle, named UCS, and base UCS handle fields and their optionality.

mapping_policy: For nonzero source handles, use the configured reference resolver when present; otherwise use remapObjectHandle. Existing Background source-registration and SUN/live-section refusal gates are unchanged.

validation.input: Generated in-memory VIEW with a locally authored Background registration and reference handles; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
validation.result: PASS for exact reference groups/values under resolver precedence and remap fallback, and for remapped VIEW group-5 identity.

qualification_limits: Generated low-level transport only; Background registration is not proof that a physical target record was emitted.
Does not establish physical producer field spans, target roles/owners, recursive graph closure, or native rendering.
Nonzero SUN and live-section references remain refused by the writer.
